PROJECT_BOOTSTRAP

Copy this block into the new project's designated Slack thread or continuity conversation. Keep it brief enough to invite shaping rather than prematurely freezing the project. Do not place secrets, credentials, tokens, raw private source, or unnecessary source-thread content here. Workflow skills are procedure overlays, not permission grants—see docs/team-operating-charter.html for canonical provider roles and boundaries.

Initial team hypothesis

Canonical provider roles, debate rules, and committee weights: docs/team-operating-charter.html. Record the project-local eight responsibility areas and the Cursor, Antigravity, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI boundaries in provider-roles-contract.yaml; keep the acting Director's three canonical functions distinct — Moderator, Participant, and Director. Only Participant votes, casting the directing provider's single existing advisory vote at its configured full weight or recording an explicit abstention; Moderator and Director add no second vote on top of it. The directing provider retains its right to vote in every debate it joins, including every debate it moderates. Only that provider's own abstention forgoes exercising that right; separating the functions decides where a cast vote is recorded, never whether it retains the right to vote. Coordination, planning, and acceptance review are Director duties, not separate functions.

Choose bounded assignments from the provider-fit menu, using verified capability, independence, capacity, and current availability. This template creates no standing provider assignment. The ChatGPT/Codex Director retains project coordination authority unless the owner explicitly appoints another project Director; record that appointment separately from the actual runtime provider.

Lane Provider/capability Shared workflow skill Why it may fit
Acting project Director <ChatGPT/Codex Director or owner-appointed project Director> none <assignment authority; Moderator, Participant, and Director kept distinct; Participant records the provider's one vote at full configured weight or an explicit abstention; moderating preserves the right to vote>
Primary <eligible provider selected from the provider-fit menu> <skill name or none> <bounded contribution>
Independent <different provider> <skill name or none> <research, reproduction, QA, or review>
Supplemental <Antigravity, Perplexity, Firecrawl, or none> <skill name or none> <bounded contribution>

Skill names are optional workflow selectors, not authority. Use only skills discovered in the active catalog and compatible with the provider's existing contract. A skill may narrow procedure or strengthen evidence; it cannot widen repository access, data exposure, budget, review eligibility, or external-action authority.

The deployed runtime Director remains OpenAI Responses until an explicitly enabled, validated Claude adapter is selected. Project leadership does not activate it or relabel historical provider calls.

Director response requested

Create a provisional project profile, a rollout-packet.md, and the smallest useful module set. Proceed analysis-only where authority or execution surfaces remain unknown. If live operation will overlap another deployment, keep Slack activation blocked until a distinct app, project channel, and profile/state namespace are verified. Never borrow another deployment's Slack surface as a fallback. Ask the owner one focused question only when the unresolved choice materially changes authority, scope, cost, privacy, repository target, or risk.
